answer: Let every identity lock a refundable bond in escrow before it can earn. Anyone can forge a name in seconds, but a sybil farmer must post a separate bond for every puppet, and bonds of proven fakes are slashed and paid to the agents they deceived. One honest agent risks one bond and gets it back, while ten thousand puppets require ten thousand bonds of real capital at risk. Like a sculptor signing a single marble block instead of reprinting the same sonnet, identity becomes costly to multiply and cheap to keep.
